title: 第11章 剧本不对啊第12章 老坑壁
slug: 百世轮回词条无限累加
lines: 苏璃躺在硬板床上。
腰还是酸。
那种酸是从骨头缝里透出来的。
他手里捏着那本深蓝色的居民证，反复摩挲。
就像是在摸一块刚出炉的金砖。
有了这东西，算是有了个在这个世界立足的根基。
不用担心走在大街上被治安官抓去填护城河。
也不用担心被奴隶贩子套上麻袋卖到矿山。
但钱是个大问题。
更何况，这世道乱得很。
奥伦达王国和巴里斯帝国打得脑浆子都出来了。
灰鸥港虽然偏僻，但也是王国的一块肉。
他记得这个地方有段时间是被敌军占领了一段时间的，但对前世的他没影响，因为不管在哪边他都是奴隶。
这一纸居民证，挡不住长枪大炮。
挡不住那些杀红了眼的兵痞。
得变强。
苏璃翻了个身。
床板发出嘎吱一声惨叫。
他看向还在桌边数钱的老杰克。
这老东西数得专心致志。
那只独眼里的光，比桌上的油灯还亮。
一枚枚金币在他手里跳跃。
发出清脆的碰撞声。
苏璃清了清嗓子。
“老东西。”
老杰克头都没抬。
“有屁放。”
“没看我正忙着吗？”
苏璃坐起来。
靠在墙上。
“我想问个事。”
“这世界上，有没有那种……”
苏璃比划了一下。
“就是那种能一拳打死牛，或者手搓火球的人？”
老杰克数钱的手停住了。
他抬起头。
像看傻子一样看着苏璃。
“你脑子被那三个娘们夹坏了？”
苏璃没理会他的嘲讽。
“正经的。”
“我以前在码头听那些行商吹牛。”
“说这世界上有骑士，还有法师。”
content_en:
Su Li was lying on the hard bed.
My waist is still sore.
That acid comes out of the cracks in the bones.
He held the dark blue resident card in his hand and rubbed it repeatedly.
It's like touching a freshly minted gold brick.
With this thing, you have a foundation to stand in this world.
Don’t worry about walking down the street and being arrested by the sheriff to fill in the moat.
There is no need to worry about being put into sacks and sold to the mines by slave traders.
But money is a big issue.
What's more, the world is in chaos.
The Orenda Kingdom and the Baris Empire fought until their brains came out.
Although Gray Gull Harbor is remote, it is also a piece of meat of the kingdom.
He remembered that this place was occupied by enemy forces for a while, but it had no impact on him in his previous life because he was a slave no matter where he was.
This piece of resident certificate cannot stop guns and cannons.
He couldn't stop those bloodthirsty soldiers.
Gotta get stronger.
Su Li turned over.
The bed board creaked and screamed.
He looked at Old Jack, who was still counting money at the table.
This old guy is very focused on counting.
The light in that one eye was brighter than the oil lamp on the table.
Gold coins jumped in his hand.
It makes a crisp collision sound.
Su Li cleared her throat.
"Old thing."
Old Jack didn't even look up.
"There's fart."
"Didn't you see that I was busy?"
Su Li sat up.
Lean against the wall.
"I want to ask something."
"Say."
"Is there such a thing in this world..."
Su Li made a gesture.
"The kind of person who can kill a cow with one punch or rub a ball of fire with his hands?"
Old Jack stopped counting the money.
He looked up.
He looked at Su Li like a fool.
"Have your brain been damaged by those three girls?"
Su Li ignored his sarcasm.
"Serious."
"I used to listen to those merchants bragging at the dock."
"There are knights and mages in this world."
